decision: Do not spend additional validation cycles crawling individual historical Eurostat retail releases. Preserve the verified partial PIT chain, exclude Retail Volume from PIT-dependent EUR backtests where full historical coverage is required, and proceed with the remaining G8 reconstruction.
backtest_rule: Never substitute current revised retail history for missing PIT observations. Retail may be used only on checkpoints where an official dated first-release observation is verified; otherwise the Retail input is WITHHELD and the macro block must be computed from eligible PIT inputs according to the frozen missing-input rules.
preservation_rule: Keep all verified Eurostat release-chain rows and source URLs for future completion; do not delete the partial reconstruction.
reason: Repeated brute-force, yearly, monthly, and deterministic release-chain crawls encountered unstable historical Eurostat URL/PDF availability and rate/runner limits. Additional crawling has diminishing validation value relative to continuing the G8 PIT program.
next_step: Proceed with EUR PIT construction using the already verified Industrial Production, Unemployment and Employment series, then continue the G8 common-sample reconstruction. Negotiated Wages remains a separate source-identity gap and must not be conflated with Retail Volume.
